title: EXCEPT / INTERSECT
description:
## EXCEPT
EXCEPT returns rows from the first query that DON'T appear in the second query. Like UNION's opposite.
```sql
SELECT name FROM all_users
EXCEPT
SELECT name FROM banned_users;
```
This gives you all users who aren't banned.

## INTERSECT
INTERSECT returns only rows that appear in BOTH queries.
```sql
SELECT name FROM customers
INTERSECT
SELECT name FROM employees;
```
This finds people who are both customers and employees.

---
## Assignment:
BWS has an `active_staff` table and a `on_vacation` table. Find all staff members who are NOT on vacation. Use EXCEPT. (only select name)
